And good evening, I'm Erin Burnett.

sentences.zh: 今晚的焦点，总统特朗普

sentences.zh: 面临的最大威胁——他的名字，也是一个人，就是杰里·纳德勒。

sentences.zh: 杰里·纳德勒。

sentences.en: Jerry Nadler of New
sentences.zh: 来自纽约的杰里

sentences.en: York, the Democratic head of the House Judiciary Committee.
sentences.zh: ·纳德勒，众议院司法委员会的民主党籍主席。

sentences.en: The committee with the power to lead impeachment proceedings against the President of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这个委员会拥有对美国总统发起弹劾程序的权力。

sentences.en: He is investigating, quote,
sentences.zh: 他正在调查，引用原话：

sentences.en: allegations of obstruction of justice, public corruption, and other abuses of power.
sentences.zh: “妨碍司法公正、公众腐败和其他滥用权力的指控”。

sentences.en: Democrats, led by House Judiciary Chairman Jerry Nadler, are carpet bombing the White House with document requests.
sentences.zh: 在众议院司法委员会主席杰里·纳德勒的领导下，民主党人正用海量文件请求对白宫发起“地毯式轰炸”。

sentences.en: He's now facing a brand new investigation, the widest since the launch of the Mueller inquiry.
sentences.zh: 他现在面临一项全新的调查，这是自穆勒调查启动以来规模最大的一次。

sentences.en: This has given folks at the White House an idea of what they're in for for the next two years or so, as Democrats lay the groundwork for 2020 and a possible impeachment.
sentences.zh: 这让白宫的人大致了解了未来两年左右他们将面临什么，因为民主党人正在为2020年大选和可能的弹劾奠定基础。

You can do the fives.

sentences.en: Hello, Congressman.
sentences.zh: 您好，议员先生。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi, how are you?
sentences.zh: 你好，最近怎么样？

sentences.en: Okay, how are you?
sentences.zh: 还好，你呢？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Thank you again for making some time for us.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢您拨冗接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激。

sentences.en: You're quite welcome.
sentences.zh: 不用客气。

sentences.en: So, Congressman, over the last couple of weeks on The Daily, we've explained to listeners how the Mueller report will be released.
sentences.zh: 那么，议员先生，在过去几周的《每日新闻》节目中，我们向听众解释了穆勒报告将如何发布。

sentences.en: It goes to the Attorney General.
sentences.zh: 它会提交给司法部长。

sentences.en: The Attorney General then releases a report on the report that goes to Congress.
sentences.zh: 然后司法部长会发布一份关于该报告的报告，并提交给国会。

sentences.en: And we've explained that it will either say we have evidence the President committed a crime or we don't have that evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们解释过，报告要么会说“我们有证据表明总统犯罪了”，要么会说“我们没有这些证据”。

sentences.en: We wanted to talk to you about what happens when that report gets to you.
sentences.zh: 我们想和您谈谈，当这份报告交到您手上时会发生什么。

sentences.en: We investigate further.
sentences.zh: 我们会作进一步调查。

sentences.en: The fact that he committed a crime is of great intereSt. It's not necessarily a guarantee of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 他犯了罪这一事实非常重要，但这并不必然保证会遭到弹劾。

sentences.en: Those are two different tests, as you know.
sentences.zh: 如您所知，这是两个不同的标准。

sentences.en: We have a responsibility well beyond the Mueller report.
sentences.zh: 我们的责任远超穆勒报告的范畴。

sentences.en: We have an obligation to do our own work.
sentences.zh: 我们有义务做好我们自己的工作。

sentences.en: The Mueller report is only for what happened with respect to Russian interference to the election and with complicity by Americans
sentences.zh: 穆勒报告仅关注俄罗斯对选举干预的情况、美国人在其中的共谋，

sentences.en: in that interference and what crimes were committed and by whom.
sentences.zh: 以及犯下了什么罪行、是谁犯下的。

sentences.en: We have to be considerably broader.
sentences.zh: 我们的视野必须广阔得多。

sentences.en: I mean, that's part of our work.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是我们工作的一部分。

sentences.en: But our basic work is to provide for the rule of law, make sure that the rule of law is protected.
sentences.zh: 但我们的基本工作是捍卫法治，确保法治得到保护。

sentences.en: That means that we have to look into obstruction of justice, into corruption, into abuses of power.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们必须调查妨碍司法公正、腐败以及滥用权力。

sentences.en: And certainly what Mueller's looking into is part of that.
sentences.zh: 当然，穆勒调查的内容是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: But we have to be much broader.
sentences.zh: 但我们的范围必须广泛得多。

sentences.en: You said that a Mueller report that says the President committed a crime is not necessarily grounds for impeachment.
sentences.zh: 您曾说过，一份认定总统犯罪的穆勒报告不一定构成了弹劾的理由。

sentences.en: Can you help me understand what you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 您能帮我理解一下您这是什么意思吗？

sentences.en: What's a scenario in which the Mueller report says the President committed a crime, but wouldn't equal impeachment necessarily, in your mind?
sentences.zh: 在您看来，会出现这样一种情况吗：穆勒报告说总统犯了罪，但在您看来并不一定等同于弹劾？

sentences.en: Well, you have to understand that not every crime is an impeachable offense.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你必须明白，并非每一种罪行都是可弹劾的罪行。

sentences.en: And an impeachable offense needn't be a crime.
sentences.zh: 而且可弹劾的罪行也不一定非得是犯罪。

sentences.en: They're two different tests.
sentences.zh: 这是两个不同的标准。

sentences.en: So, for example, if the Mueller report were to show that the President committed perjury, with respect to money laundering in, you know, five years ago in some scheme in New York
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，如果穆勒报告显示总统犯了伪证罪，关于洗钱，你知道的，五年前在纽约的某种计划中，

sentences.en: to cheat the, I don't know, that would not be impeachable.
sentences.zh: 为了欺骗——我不知道，那将是不可弹劾的。

sentences.en: Because impeachment is an abuse of presidential power for the purpose or with the effect of aggregating power to the executive, of damaging liberty or the structure and function
sentences.zh: 因为弹劾是指为了将权力集中到行政部门、损害自由或政府的结构与功能、

sentences.en: of government, the separation of powers.
sentences.zh: 破坏三权分立的目的或产生这种效果而滥用总统权力。

sentences.en: That's what's impeachable.
sentences.zh: 这才是可弹劾的。

sentences.en: Also, corruptly obtaining an election would be impeachable.
sentences.zh: 同样，通过腐败手段赢得选举也是可弹劾的。

sentences.en: But crimes that don't bear on that would not be impeachable.
sentences.zh: 但与此无关的罪行则不可弹劾。

sentences.en: So I said 20 years ago that the President's perjury about a private sexual affair was not impeachable.
sentences.zh: 所以我20年前就说过，总统关于私人性丑闻的伪证是不可弹劾的。

sentences.en: And if President Trump were to be shown to have perjured himself about some business deal, that would not be impeachable.
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普总统被证明在某些商业交易上作了伪证，那也是不可弹劾的。

sentences.en: But if he were shown to commit perjury or to do something else that affected the structure and function of government or democratic rights or the integrity
sentences.zh: 但如果他被证明犯有伪证罪，或做了其他影响政府结构与功能、民主权利或选举完整性的事情，

sentences.en: of elections, that would be impeachable.
sentences.zh: 那将是可弹劾的。

sentences.en: So what do you do if the Mueller report says that the President committed a crime like money laundering five years ago, but did not commit what you see as an impeachable offense?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果穆勒报告说总统五年前犯下了洗钱等罪行，但没有犯下您认为可弹劾的罪行，您会怎么做？

sentences.en: Well, if the President was shown to have committed a crime of money laundering five years ago, I would hope in New York that he should be prosecuted for that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果总统被证明在五年前犯下了洗钱罪，我希望他在纽约因此受到起诉。

sentences.en: In New York, right?
sentences.zh: 在纽约，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, in New York, by the federal Southern District of New York or by the New York authorities or both, period.
sentences.zh: 对，在纽约，由联邦纽约南区检察官办公室、纽约地方当局或两者共同起诉，就这样。

sentences.en: That's the criminal justice system.
sentences.zh: 那是刑事司法系统的事。

sentences.en: Now, the Justice Department maintains, wrongly in my opinion, that a sitting president cannot be indicted while in office.
sentences.zh: 现在，司法部坚持认为——在我看来是错误的——在任总统在职期间不能被起诉。

sentences.en: So they will not indict a president for committing some crime.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不会因总统犯下某种罪行而起诉他。

sentences.en: I think it's the wrong policy.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是错误的政策。

sentences.en: I think they should be able to indict a president while he's in office, but that's not the real function of what we're doing in our committee.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们应该能够在总统在任期间起诉他，但这并不是我们在委员会中所做工作的真正职能。

sentences.en: Our committee's job is not a criminal justice job.
sentences.zh: 我们委员会的工作不是刑事司法工作。

sentences.en: That's up to the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 那是司法部的事。

sentences.en: That's up to the New York state authorities.
sentences.zh: 那是纽约州当局的事。

sentences.en: Our job is to protect the structure of democratic government and the liberties of the people.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作是保护民主政府的结构和人民的自由。

sentences.en: If the president committed a crime that has nothing to do with this, well, he ought to be prosecuted, but that's not our business.
sentences.zh: 如果总统犯下的罪行与此无关，好吧，他应该被起诉，但那不关我们的事。

sentences.en: We're not a law enforcement agent.
sentences.zh: 我们不是执法机构。

sentences.en: Okay, well, let's flip this around and say the Mueller report finds that the president committed a crime that is absolutely grounds for impeachment.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们换个角度，假设穆勒报告发现总统犯下的罪行绝对构成了弹劾的理由。

sentences.en: What do you do then?
sentences.zh: 那你们会怎么做？

sentences.en: Well, we have to further investigate it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们必须作进一步调查。

sentences.en: Let's put it this way.
sentences.zh: 这么说吧。

sentences.en: We have to do all these investigations now that we're starting to do.
sentences.zh: 我们必须开展现在正要着手的所有这些调查。

sentences.en: Focused on obstruction, corruption, abuse of power, obstruction of justice, etc.
sentences.zh: 专注于妨碍、腐败、滥用权力、妨碍司法公正等。

sentences.en: If we find that the president is guilty of that, then we have to decide what we can do about it.
sentences.zh: 如果我们发现总统确实犯有这些罪行，那么我们必须决定我们可以为此做些什么。

sentences.en: Impeachment is one option, but impeachment is the decision to be made further down the road, and it's a very high bar, but it certainly would be on the table if we
sentences.zh: 弹劾是一个选项，但弹劾是以后要作出的决定，而且门槛非常高，但如果我们

sentences.en: were to find that.
sentences.zh: 发现了这一点，它肯定会被提上议事日程。

sentences.en: Do you know what the bar is in your mind?
sentences.zh: 您心目中的门槛是什么？

sentences.en: Yes, and I've said it many times.
sentences.zh: 是的，我已经说过很多次了。

sentences.en: I think there's a threefold test for impeachment, really.
sentences.zh: 我认为弹劾实际上有一个三重标准。

sentences.en: Number one, has the president committed impeachable offenses?
sentences.zh: 第一，总统是否犯下了可弹劾的罪行？

sentences.en: Number two, are those serious?
sentences.zh: 第二，这些罪行是否严重？

sentences.en: And if the answer to the first two is yes, I think there's one further test, and that is impeachment cannot be partisan.
sentences.zh: 如果前两个问题的答案是肯定的，我认为还有一个标准，那就是弹劾不能带有党派偏见。

sentences.en: What you don't want to do is divide the country so that half the country thinks for the next
sentences.zh: 你最不想看到的是分裂国家，导致未来

sentences.en: 30 years, we won the election, you stole it from us.
sentences.zh: 30年里，一半的人认为“我们赢了选举，你们把它从我们这里偷走了”。

sentences.en: You don't want to embitter the country.
sentences.zh: 你不想让国家充满痛苦与怨恨。

sentences.en: The situation has to be such that you believe when you start the impeachment proceeding that the
sentences.zh: 情况必须是这样的：当你启动弹劾程序时，你坚信

sentences.en: evidence you have is so persuasive of such terrible deeds that once the evidence is laid out, an
sentences.zh: 你拥有的证据如此具有说服力，证明了如此可怕的行径，以至于一旦证据公布，

sentences.en: appreciable fraction of the voters who voted for Trump will reluctantly say you had to do it, you know, just trying to steal the election.
sentences.zh: 相当一部分投票给特朗普的选民也会勉强承认“你们不得不这么做”，你知道的，而不是仅仅为了窃取选举。

sentences.en: But the first two conditions you laid out, is it impeachable?
sentences.zh: 但您刚才提出的前两个条件：是否可弹劾？

sentences.en: Is it serious?
sentences.zh: 是否严重？

sentences.en: Those feel quite subjective.
sentences.zh: 听起来相当主观。

sentences.en: So I wonder if any argument to impeach will inevitably feel partisan and therefore make your third condition hard, which is consensus.
sentences.zh: 所以我纳闷，任何弹劾的论点是否都不可避免地带有党派色彩，从而使得您的第三个条件——达成共识——变得困难？

sentences.en: Any argument to impeach is going to be political.
sentences.zh: 任何弹劾的论点都将是政治性的。

sentences.en: Impeachment is a political task, and it's intended to be by the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 弹劾是一项政治任务，宪法原本赋予它的就是这个目的。

sentences.en: Yes, it's going to be subjective.
sentences.zh: 是的，它将是主观的。

sentences.en: All political decisions are subjective.
sentences.zh: 所有的政治决定都是主观的。

sentences.en: I shouldn't say that.
sentences.zh: 我不该这么说。

sentences.en: Almost all political decisions are subjective.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有的政治决定都是主观的。

sentences.en: But if this occurs, people are going to be on both sides, and some people will think you're fair and some won't.
sentences.zh: 但如果发生这种情况，人们会站在不同的立场上，有些人会认为你很公正，有些人则不会。

sentences.en: But, you know, you have to really depend on the facts that you have at that point.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，你必须真正依赖你当时掌握的事实。

sentences.en: You have to have very strong proof of very dire facts.
sentences.zh: 你必须拥有关于极其严重的事实的极强有力的证据。

sentences.en: And by the way, let me just step back.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，请允许我退一步说。

sentences.en: I'm a little concerned that we're talking too much about impeachment.
sentences.zh: 我有点担心我们对弹劾谈论得太多了。

sentences.en: Our goal is not impeachment.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标不是弹劾。

sentences.en: Our goal is what I said a few minutes ago.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标正如我几分钟前所说的那样。

sentences.en: To protect the rule of law, to protect the structure and functioning of government, to protect our liberties.
sentences.zh: 保护法治，保护政府的结构与运作，保护我们的自由。

sentences.en: That's the basic goal.
sentences.zh: 这才是基本目标。

sentences.en: And if we can do that without impeachment, fine.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能在没有弹劾的情况下做到这一点，很好。

sentences.en: If we have to do impeachment, and if we meet the requirements so that we think we can do it, also fine.
sentences.zh: 如果我们必须进行弹劾，并且如果我们符合要求，认为我们能够做到，那也很好。

sentences.en: Understood.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: I want to ask you about some of the comments you have made ahead of the release of the Mueller report.
sentences.zh: 我想问您关于您在穆勒报告发布前发表的一些言论。

sentences.en: You were asked a question, and in your response, you said that you believed the president obstructed justice.
sentences.zh: 有人向您提问，在您的回答中，您说您相信总统妨碍了司法公正。

sentences.en: And I wonder why you would...
sentences.zh: 我想知道为什么您会……

sentences.en: Let me say the following.
sentences.zh: 请允许我这样说。

sentences.en: I think there's a lot of evidence the president obstructed justice, but we have to go a lot further.
sentences.zh: 我认为有大量证据表明总统妨碍了司法公正，但我们必须走得更远。

sentences.en: We have to know a lot more.
sentences.zh: 我们必须了解更多。

sentences.en: But I wonder why you would say that publicly before the release of the Mueller report.
sentences.zh: 但我想知道，为什么您会在穆勒报告发布之前公开这么说？

sentences.en: What's the value in doing that?
sentences.zh: 这样做有什么价值？

sentences.en: Does it not kind of inherently portray whatever investigations you're...
sentences.zh: 这难道不会从本质上让人觉得无论你们在进行什么调查……

sentences.en: I was even answering questions honestly.
sentences.zh: 我当时只是在诚实地回答问题。

sentences.en: I was asked the question.
sentences.zh: 有人问了我这个问题。

sentences.en: I didn't volunteer it.
sentences.zh: 我并非主动提起。

sentences.en: I was asked the question.
sentences.zh: 是别人问了我这个问题。

sentences.en: And I said, yes, I think certain things which are...
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，我认为某些事情是……

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I like asking questions, but why not say, why not say, let's wait until the Mueller report comes out?
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢提问，但为什么不说，为什么不说，让我们等到米勒报告出来再说呢？

sentences.en: Well, maybe I should have.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也许我应该那样做。

sentences.en: But the fact is, I think certain things that are in the public record
sentences.zh: 但事实是，我认为公开记录中的某些事情

sentences.en: make a strong case that there was obstruction.
sentences.zh: 充分证明了存在妨碍司法公正的行为。

sentences.en: And other people said the same thing.
sentences.zh: 其他人也说过同样的话。

sentences.en: But a strong case is not proof.
sentences.zh: 但有充分的理由并不等于证据确凿。

sentences.en: I should say a strong case.
sentences.zh: 我应该说是有充分的理由。

sentences.en: I should say a lot of evidence is a better way of putting it.
sentences.zh: 换个更好的说法，我应该说有大量的证据。

sentences.en: That's not necessarily proof.
sentences.zh: 这并不一定就是证据。

sentences.en: And certainly not enough to convince the country at this point.
sentences.zh: 而且在这一点上，绝对不足以说服全国。

sentences.en: And we have to have a lot more evidence and a lot more facts.
sentences.zh: 我们需要更多的证据和更多的事实。

sentences.en: And we need to know what the Mueller report said.
sentences.zh: 我们需要知道米勒报告说了什么。

sentences.en: And we may need to know a lot more than the Mueller report says.
sentences.zh: 我们可能还需要知道比米勒报告所说多得多的大量内容。

sentences.en: So re-asking the same question now that I think you were asked about 10 days or so ago, do you believe the president obstructed justice?
sentences.zh: 所以，现在重新提出大约十天前可能问过你的同一个问题，你认为总统妨碍了司法公正吗？

sentences.en: I think there's a lot of evidence that he obstructed justice.
sentences.zh: 我认为有大量证据表明他妨碍了司法公正。

sentences.en: And Mueller will tell us a lot more about that.
sentences.zh: 米勒会向我们透露更多这方面的信息。

sentences.en: And it's one of the things we have to know.
sentences.zh: 这是我们必须了解的事情之一。

sentences.en: Are you concerned, and I appreciate you saying that maybe you shouldn't have said it, but are you concerned that people will see this as a preconceived judgment?
sentences.zh: 你是否担心——我很感激你刚才说也许不该那么说——但你是否担心人们会认为这是先入为主的判断？

sentences.en: I know that at least some of your colleagues like Jim Jordan do see it that way.
sentences.zh: 我知道至少你的某些同僚，比如吉姆·乔丹，就是这么看的。

sentences.en: Heading into these investigations.
sentences.zh: 在进入这些调查之际。

sentences.en: No matter what I say or do, they're going to say that.
sentences.zh: 无论我说什么或做什么，他们都会这么说。

sentences.en: It's the Republican strategy to say, I decided to impeach the president day after the election.
sentences.zh: 共和党的策略就是说，我在选举后的第二天就决定弹劾总统。

sentences.en: It's just an attempt to distract.
sentences.zh: 这只是一种转移视线的企图。

sentences.en: We haven't decided, I haven't decided to impeach.
sentences.zh: 我们还没决定，我还没决定弹劾。

sentences.en: Some people have said that when I say, especially that third requirement, it's a very high bar.
sentences.zh: 有些人说，当我提到特别是第三个要求时，这是一个很高的标准。

sentences.en: And some people have said that it may be an impossible bar.
sentences.zh: 还有人说这可能是一个不可能达到的标准。

sentences.en: It may be.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: The three tests that I've said, I didn't invent.
sentences.zh: 我提到的这三个标准，并不是我发明的。

sentences.en: When we had the
sentences.zh: 当我们在

sentences.en: Clinton impeachment and I was a junior member of the committee, the first thing I did was to try to
sentences.zh: 克林顿弹劾案时，我是委员会的资深成员，我做的第一件事就是尝试

sentences.en: get my hands on everything that's been written from Blackstone onward as to what's an impeachable offense.
sentences.zh: 弄到从布莱克斯通开始的所有关于什么是可弹劾罪行的文件。

sentences.en: But the second thing I did 20 years ago was I demanded that before we held hearings of the committee on fact, we first hold a hearing on what's an impeachable offense.
sentences.zh: 但20年我做的第二件事是，我要求在委员会举行事实听证会之前，首先就什么是可弹劾罪行举行听证会。

sentences.en: And even though I was a minority member of the committee, I persuaded people and we did that.
sentences.zh: 尽管我是委员会的少数党成员，但我说服了大家，我们做到了。

sentences.en: And so what
sentences.zh: 所以

sentences.en: I've been talking about is basically what I got from that.
sentences.zh: 我一直在谈论的，基本上就是我从中得到的。

sentences.en: It's not, I didn't make up this teSt.
sentences.zh: 这不是，我没有捏造这个标准。

sentences.en: Well, Congressman, I do have to point out that you said that we were talking too much about impeachment, but now you are talking about impeachment.
sentences.zh: 议员先生，我确实不得不指出，你曾说我们对弹劾谈论得太多，但现在你在谈论弹劾。

sentences.en: Okay, fair enough.
sentences.zh: 好吧，言之有理。

sentences.en: But I'm trying to say, you know, what I'm trying to say is we're not focused on that.
sentences.zh: 但我想说的是，你知道，我想说的是我们并没有把重点放在那上面。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We will take the facts where they lead.
sentences.zh: 我们将顺着事实走向去处理。

sentences.en: And we'll see.
sentences.zh: 我们会拭目以待。

sentences.en: I want to stay with the topic of Mueller for a moment.
sentences.zh: 我想继续讨论米勒的话题。

sentences.en: You and your colleagues have held up Robert Mueller as a kind of gold standard of objectivity and fairness in all of this.
sentences.zh: 你和你的同僚一直把罗伯特·米勒奉为这一切中客观和公正的某种黄金标准。

sentences.en: As somebody who has the integrity, the background to kind of handle this properly, you have a lot of faith in him.
sentences.zh: 作为一个有诚信、有背景能够妥善处理此事的人，你对她充满信心。

sentences.en: Do you agree that there's basically no path to impeachment, and sorry to use the word again, if the Mueller report finds no crimes?
sentences.zh: 如果米勒报告没有发现任何犯罪行为，你是否同意基本上没有通往弹劾的道路——抱歉再次使用这个词？

sentences.en: No, not necessarily.
sentences.zh: 不，不一定。

sentences.en: It depends what else we find.
sentences.zh: 这取决于我们还会发现什么。

sentences.en: Depends what else is going on.
sentences.zh: 取决于还会发生什么。

sentences.en: There may be a lot of other things that we have to look into and that may be very damning.
sentences.zh: 可能还有很多其他事情我们需要调查，而且可能会非常致命。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And as you said earlier, there is such a thing as an impeachable offense that is not a crime.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才所说，确实存在不属于犯罪的可弹劾罪行这种说法。

sentences.en: Can you help us understand what that might look like?
sentences.zh: 你能帮我们理解那会是什么样的吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: An impeachable offense is not a crime.
sentences.zh: 可弹劾罪行不等同于犯罪。

sentences.en: Well, misuse of the pardon power, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，滥用特赦权力。

sentences.en: Misuse of other powers of the presidency.
sentences.zh: 滥用总统的其他权力。

sentences.en: It is not true, as Mayor Giuliani has said that, and as a lot of other people have said, that the president has the absolute right to
sentences.zh: 朱利安尼市长所说的不属实，许多其他人所说的不属实，即总统拥有绝对权利

sentences.en: do this, and therefore, if he does this, it cannot be wrong.
sentences.zh: 去做这件事，因此如果他这么做，就不会错。

sentences.en: The president has the right to do certain things.
sentences.zh: 总统有权做某些事情。

sentences.en: Pardons, you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是说特赦？

sentences.en: For example, the president has the absolute right to pardon anybody.
sentences.zh: 例如，总统拥有特赦任何人的绝对权力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But if the president was shown to pardon somebody in return for a $50,000 check, that would be a crime.
sentences.zh: 但如果事实证明总统为了换取5万美元的支票而特赦某人，那将是一项罪行。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: It would also be an impeachable offense.
sentences.zh: 这也将是一项可弹劾的罪行。

sentences.en: Or to obstruct an investigation.
sentences.zh: 或者妨碍调查。

sentences.en: Or to obstruct an investigation.
sentences.zh: 或者妨碍调查。

sentences.en: In other words, if he were shown for a corrupt motive.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，如果事实证明他是出于腐败动机。

sentences.en: So the motive is what counts in a lot of these things.
sentences.zh: 因此，在许多这类事情中，动机才是最重要的。

sentences.en: So in November of 2016, right after
sentences.zh: 所以，在2016年11月，就在

sentences.en: President Trump was elected, you called for then-FBI director James Comey to be forced out of his job because of how he handled the investigation of Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统当选后不久，你要求时任联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米辞职，原因是他处理希拉里·克林顿调查的方式。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And his decision not to charge her with a crime, yet still detail her wrongdoing for the public.
sentences.zh: 以及他决定不对她提出犯罪指控，却仍然向公众详细说明她的不当行为。

sentences.en: We all remember that news conference and how that worked.
sentences.zh: 我们都记得那场新闻发布会及其运作方式。

sentences.en: And you called that unforgivable.
sentences.zh: 你称之为不可原谅的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If Robert Mueller says no crime has been committed when it comes to the president, would you, as head of the Judiciary Committee, still try
sentences.zh: 如果罗伯特·米勒在涉及总统时表示没有发生任何犯罪行为，作为司法委员会的主席，你是否仍会试图

sentences.en: to bring forward to the public the information behind the Mueller investigation?
sentences.zh: 将米勒调查背后的信息公之于众？

sentences.en: And if you were to do that, I wonder what's different in your mind between what Comey did and what you would be doing.
sentences.zh: 如果你这样做，我想知道在你的心目中，科米所做的事情和你要做的事情有什么区别。

sentences.en: There's a fundamental difference.
sentences.zh: 有着根本的区别。

sentences.en: The Justice Department has a very salutary general policy.
sentences.zh: 司法部有一项非常健康的一般政策。

sentences.en: And that is, if you don't indict somebody.
sentences.zh: 那就是，如果你不起诉某人。

sentences.en: Now, why don't you indict somebody?
sentences.zh: 现在，你为什么不起诉某人？

sentences.en: You didn't have the evidence, obviously.
sentences.zh: 显然你没有证据。

sentences.en: You've investigated so-and-so.
sentences.zh: 你调查了某某。

sentences.en: You're not indicting her or him.
sentences.zh: 你没有起诉她或他。

sentences.en: You don't comment negatively.
sentences.zh: 你不做负面评论。

sentences.en: You should, in the case of public notoriety, you should announce, we've investigated, we're not indicting him.
sentences.zh: 在广为人知的情况下，你应该宣布，我们已经调查过了，我们不会起诉他。

sentences.en: That's fine.
sentences.zh: 这很好。

sentences.en: But you have a policy, which the Justice Department does, that the president cannot be indicted, no matter how much evidence, just because he's the president.
sentences.zh: 但司法部有一项政策，即无论有多少证据，仅仅因为他是总统，就不能起诉总统。

sentences.en: Therefore, we can't comment on evidence against him or anything else.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们不能对针对他的证据或任何其他事情发表评论。

sentences.en: Then you're converting a normally good policy into a cover-up.
sentences.zh: 那么你就是把一项原本很好的政策变成了一种掩盖。

sentences.en: And you're depriving Congress of its ability to hold the president accountable.
sentences.zh: 你剥夺了国会追究总统责任的能力。

sentences.en: You, the Justice Department, won't hold him accountable because you've said you have no right to, you can't indict him.
sentences.zh: 你，司法部，不会追究他的责任，因为你说你没有权利，你不能起诉他。

sentences.en: That leaves only Congress.
sentences.zh: 这就只剩下国会了。

sentences.en: And now you're going to deny
sentences.zh: 现在你要剥夺

sentences.en: Congress the right to the information that makes the president unaccountable and above the law.
sentences.zh: 国会获取信息的权利，这使得总统不受问责且凌驾于法律之上。

sentences.en: And that cannot be.
sentences.zh: 这是绝对不行的。

sentences.en: But just to be clear, if Mueller says no crimes, the public still needs to see the evidence, regardless, because the rules are different here.
sentences.zh: 但为了明确起见，如果米勒说没有犯罪，公众无论如何仍然需要看到证据，因为这里的规则不同。

sentences.en: No, the public needs to see the evidence, number one, so it can be confident that it's true.
sentences.zh: 不，公众需要看到证据，第一，这样才能确信它是真的。

sentences.en: I mean, we've tried to protect Mueller because by all accounts, he's an honest guy, et cetera, et cetera, and the investigation has to proceed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们一直试图保护米勒，因为各方都认为他是个诚实的人，等等，等等，而且调查必须进行下去。

sentences.en: But whatever he says, you can't take it on faith.
sentences.zh: 但无论他说什么，你都不能盲目相信。

sentences.en: We don't operate that way.
sentences.zh: 我们不是那样运作的。

sentences.en: We shouldn't take things on faith.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该盲目相信事物。

sentences.en: And if he says the president has committed crimes, we should know what the evidence is.
sentences.zh: 如果他说总统犯了罪，我们应该知道证据是什么。

sentences.en: If he says the president hasn't committed crimes, we should know what the evidence is.
sentences.zh: 如果他说总统没有犯罪，我们应该知道证据是什么。

sentences.en: And if the president hasn't committed crimes, but has done terrible things that he knows about, we should know that too.
sentences.zh: 如果总统没有犯罪，但做过他知道的糟糕事情，我们也应该知道。

sentences.en: Or if the president has done nothing wrong, we should know that.
sentences.zh: 或者如果总统没有做错任何事，我们也应该知道。

sentences.en: And the public has a great interest in the president, obviously.
sentences.zh: 显然，公众对总统有着极大的兴趣。

sentences.en: So I just want to be very clear on why the case of Comey is different from the case of Mueller
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想非常明确地说明为什么科米的情况与米勒的情况不同

sentences.en: essentially because when he announced that he wasn't indicting Hillary, it was because he thought there wasn't enough evidence to indict Hillary.
sentences.zh: 本质上是因为当他宣布不指控希拉里时，是因为他认为没有足够的证据指控希拉里。

sentences.en: The normal reason you don't indict somebody.
sentences.zh: 你不指控某人的正常原因。

sentences.en: If Mueller decides not to indict the president, then the public ought to know that and hear that and see the evidence on which he bases that.
sentences.zh: 如果米勒决定不起诉总统，那么公众应该知道这一点，听到这一点，并看到他据此做出决定的证据。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I want to talk to you, Congressman, about the politics of all of this and what the path forward might mean for the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 所以我想和你谈谈，议员先生，关于这一切的政治以及前进的道路对民主党意味着什么。

sentences.en: Because as you know, the Republican Party has stood solidly behind the president this entire time.
sentences.zh: 因为如你所知，共和党自始至终坚定地支持总统。

sentences.en: They have not budged at all.
sentences.zh: 他们一点也没有动摇。

sentences.en: If
sentences.zh: 如果

sentences.en: Robert Mueller says at the end of the day that no crimes have been committed by the president,
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·米勒最终说总统没有犯下任何罪行，

sentences.en: but your committee and others continue to investigate the president, are you concerned that this
sentences.zh: 但你的委员会和其他人继续调查总统，你是否担心这

sentences.en: will inflict even more damage and partisanship on an already pretty divided and highly partisan
sentences.zh: 会给本已相当分裂和高度党派化的美国公众

sentences.en: American public?
sentences.zh: 带来更多的损害和党派偏见？

sentences.en: Not if we do it responsibly.
sentences.zh: 如果我们负责任地去做，就不会。

sentences.en: And maybe hurt the Democratic Party in the process.
sentences.zh: 而且在此过程中可能会伤害民主党。

sentences.en: Not if we do it responsibly.
sentences.zh: 如果我们负责任地去做，就不会。

sentences.en: Congress must hold the executive accountable.
sentences.zh: 国会必须追究行政部门的责任。

sentences.en: And that is with respect to crimes, it's respect to bad deeds, it's respect to corruption, et cetera, and it's respect to policy.
sentences.zh: 这就是关于犯罪、坏事、腐败等以及政策方面的责任。

sentences.en: We have to provide the accountability and we have to let the American people know what is being done in their names and let them judge.
sentences.zh: 我们必须提供问责制，我们必须让美国人民知道以他们的名义正在做什么，并让他们做出判断。

sentences.en: But how do you explain to the American people who are pretty exhausted by all this, why you're going to keep pursuing an investigation after Mueller?
sentences.zh: 但是，你如何向对这一切感到非常疲惫的美国人民解释，为什么在米勒之后你还要继续进行调查？

sentences.en: Well, it depends what he says and how much he covers.
sentences.zh: 这取决于他说什么以及他涵盖了多少内容。

sentences.en: And that will help determine how much we have left to do.
sentences.zh: 这将有助于决定我们还剩下多少工作要做。

sentences.en: And the answer is that we can't rely on others to do the work for us.
sentences.zh: 答案是我们不能指望别人为我们做事。

sentences.en: We have an obligation to do our own work.
sentences.zh: 我们有义务做好我们自己的工作。

sentences.en: That's why we were elected.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们当选的原因。

sentences.en: And at the end of the day, the American people will decide not the week after Mueller releases his report, but election day
sentences.zh: 归根结底，美国人民决定的时间不是在米勒发布报告的一周后，而是明年的

sentences.en: next year, whether we have acted responsibly or irresponsibly in a partisan or reasonable way.
sentences.zh: 选举日，看我们是行事负责还是不负责，是出于党派之见还是合理行事。

sentences.en: Well, would you put your belief in the need to pursue the facts over the short-term well-being
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果这两件事似乎彼此不和且发生冲突，你会把对追求事实的需求置于民主党

sentences.en: of the Democratic Party if those two things seem to turn out to be at odds with one another and in conflict?
sentences.zh: 的短期福祉之上吗？

sentences.en: I think it's my constitutional duty to do so.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我的宪法职责。

sentences.en: This may sound a little corny, but in this moment, with everyone waiting for what's next,
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能有点老土，但在此时此刻，每个人都在等待接下来会发生什么，

sentences.en: what message do you want to give to Americans on what we can see as kind of the eve of the Mueller report?
sentences.zh: 在可以说接近米勒报告前夕的时刻，你想向美国人传达什么信息？

sentences.en: What message?
sentences.zh: 什么信息？

sentences.en: That one, we have an administration that has attacked the institutions of government and of liberty in which we depend on in fundamental ways, and we have to rein it in.
sentences.zh: 第一，我们有一个行政部门，它以根本性的方式攻击了我们所依赖的政府机构和自由，我们必须遏制它。

sentences.en: We have to make sure that the separation of powers is maintained and that liberty and the rule of law is maintained.
sentences.zh: 我们必须确保权力分立得以维持，自由和法治得以维持。

sentences.en: And that the Mueller report will give us hopefully a lot of information, but that Congress has to do the job we were elected to do.
sentences.zh: 米勒报告有望给我们提供大量信息，但国会必须做我们当选后要做的工作。

sentences.en: And that the administration has to understand that the American people elected a Congress that wants to hold the administration accountable, and we will do that.
sentences.zh: 行政部门必须明白，美国人民选举出了一个希望追究行政部门责任的国会，我们将做到这一点。

sentences.en: And the Mueller report will help us doing that to a greater or lesser extent, but it's fundamentally our job.
sentences.zh: 米勒报告将在或大或小的程度上帮助我们做到这一点，但从根本上说这是我们的工作。

sentences.en: Congressman, thank you for your time.
sentences.zh: 议员先生，谢谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的非常感激。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Okay, cheers.
sentences.zh: 好，再见。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app, unlocked.
sentences.zh: 纽约时报App，已解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅时报才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用时报一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载纽约时报App时，你的第一个月免费。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 整整一个月，带你突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the
sentences.zh: 如果你还没订阅纽约时报，今天就下载

sentences.en: Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 时报App，即可获得30天免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: We are very, very saddened.
sentences.zh: 我们感到非常、非常悲痛。

sentences.en: Our heart is broken for this tragic accident.
sentences.zh: 我们为这场悲惨的事故感到心碎。

sentences.en: On Monday, at least 22 airlines stopped flying the version of Boeing 737 jetliner that crashed
sentences.zh: 周一，至少有22家航空公司停飞了周日在埃塞俄比亚坠毁的

sentences.en: in Ethiopia on Sunday, out of fear there may be a connection to a similar crash of the same model in Indonesia six months ago.
sentences.zh: 波音737客机系列，因为担心这可能与六个月前在印度尼西亚发生的同型号客机坠毁事故有关。

sentences.en: But at least 12 other carriers, including American Airlines and Southwest Airlines, said they would continue to fly the planes as they await the conclusion
sentences.zh: 但包括美国航空和西南航空在内的至少12家其他航空公司表示，他们将继续执飞这些飞机，同时等待

sentences.en: of an investigation into the Ethiopian crash.
sentences.zh: 埃塞俄比亚空难调查结果的得出。

sentences.en: Both crashes occurred moments after takeoff, in clear flying conditions, and resulted in the death of everyone on board.
sentences.zh: 两起坠机事故都发生在起飞后不久，当时飞行条件良好，并导致机上所有人员遇难。

sentences.en: At this stage, we cannot rule out anything.
sentences.zh: 在现阶段，我们不排除任何可能性。

sentences.en: We cannot also attribute the cause to anything because we will have to comply with the international regulation to wait for the investigation to reveal the cause of the accident.
sentences.zh: 我们也不能将原因归咎于任何单一因素，因为我们必须遵守国际规则，等待调查揭示事故原因。

sentences.en: The cause of the Ethiopian Airlines crash remains unknown, but investigators have retrieved the plane's flight data and cockpit voice recorder, which are expected to provide clues.
sentences.zh: 埃塞俄比亚航空空难的原因目前尚不清楚，但调查人员已经找到了飞机的飞行数据记录器和驾驶舱语音记录器，预计它们能提供线索。

sentences.en: I wish to express my deepest condolences and prayers to the great nation of
sentences.zh: 我谨向伟大的

sentences.en: Ethiopia and to the families of the passengers and the crew members who lost their life in this tragedy.
sentences.zh: 埃塞俄比亚国家以及在这场悲剧中失去生命的乘客和机组人员家属表示最深切的哀悼和祈祷。

sentences.en: In Kenya on Monday, where the plane was headed, a week-long United Nations summit began
sentences.zh: 周一在飞机原本的目的地肯尼亚，为期一周的联合国峰会

sentences.en: with a moment of silence for the 22 UN workers who died in the crash, all of whom were scheduled to attend the summit.
sentences.zh: 在为在空难中遇难的22名联合国工作人员默哀中拉开序幕，他们原本都计划出席此次峰会。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: After 42 days without a press briefing, the longest stretch of the Trump presidency, Press Secretary Sarah Huckabee Sanders returned to the White House podium on Monday to take
sentences.zh: 在创下特朗普总统任期内最长纪录的42天没有举行记者会之后，白宫新闻秘书萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯于周一重返白宫讲台，接受

sentences.en: questions from reporters.
sentences.zh: 记者们的提问。

sentences.en: Does the president really believe Democrats hate Jews?
sentences.zh: 总统真的认为民主党人讨厌犹太人吗？

sentences.en: Look, the president's been an unwavering and committed ally to Israel and the Jewish people.
sentences.zh: 听着，总统一直是 اسرائیل（以色列）和犹太人民坚定不移的忠实盟友。

sentences.en: And frankly, the remarks that have been made by a number of Democrats and failed to be called out by
sentences.zh: 坦白说，多位民主党人发表了那些言论，而民主党领导层

sentences.en: Democrat leadership is frankly abhorrent and it's sad.
sentences.zh: 却没有站出来谴责，坦白讲这令人反感，也很悲哀。

sentences.en: During the briefing, reporters repeatedly pressed
sentences.zh: 在记者会期间，记者们一再追问

sentences.en: Sanders on why Trump recently said that the Democratic Party is anti-Jewish and reportedly told campaign donors over the weekend that Democrats, quote, hate Jewish people.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯，为什么特朗普最近会说民主党反犹太人，据报道他在周末还对竞选金主说民主党人“恨犹太人”。

sentences.en: You didn't say yes or no.
sentences.zh: 你刚才没有回答是或否。

sentences.en: Does he really believe Democrats hate Jews?
sentences.zh: 他真的认为民主党人讨厌犹太人吗？

sentences.en: I'm just trying to get a sense of that.
sentences.zh: 我只是想弄清楚这一点。

sentences.en: I think that's a question you ought to ask the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我想这个问题你应该去问民主党人。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》将为我们做好假期招待客人的准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会喝到断片才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在纽约时报App或你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
